headline: Dunmore Packaging reports minor shipment delays at Penang plant
body: Dunmore Packaging confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Penang plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Data breach at Dunmore Packaging exposes customer records
body: Dunmore Packaging disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.

headline: Dunmore Packaging opens new production line in Penang
body: Dunmore Packaging commissioned a new line at its Penang site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Dunmore Packaging publishes annual sustainability report
body: Dunmore Packaging released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Dunmore Packaging faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Dunmore Packaging. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Dunmore Packaging labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Dunmore Packaging. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.
